## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Tenant-scoped number series: `CORE_NUMBER_SERIES` holds one row per series code and period (`CODE`, `PREFIX`,
`PATTERN` with `{PREFIX} {YYYY} {YY} {MM} {SEQ:n} {TENANT}`, `RESET_POLICY` `NEVER | YEARLY | MONTHLY`,
`NEXT_VALUE`), unique on `(TENANT_ID, CODE, PERIOD_KEY)`. `NumberSeriesApi.next(code)` allocates atomically in its
own transaction (`REQUIRES_NEW`; a rolled-back caller leaves a gap); `preview(code)` shows the next number without
consuming it. Series are managed at `/api/v1/sequence/series` and copied to new tenants with the counter at 1.
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
For every human-readable document number: order, invoice, voucher, ticket, batch. The module seeds the series
(`V1000+`, `TENANT_ID = 1`), calls `next` when the document is created and stores the string in its own column,
unique with `TENANT_ID`. Not for primary keys (those come from `SEQ_<TABLE>`) and not for anything a user
never reads.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// allocate when the document is created (inside the service's transaction)
order.setOrderNo(numberSeriesApi.next(ShopSeries.SHOP_ORDER));   // e.g. ORD-2026-000123

// show the number the next order will get
String next = numberSeriesApi.preview(ShopSeries.SHOP_ORDER);
```

```sql
-- V1000+: the series for PLATFORM; new tenants receive a copy with the counter at 1
INSERT INTO CORE_NUMBER_SERIES (ID, TENANT_ID, CODE, PREFIX, PATTERN, RESET_POLICY, CREATED_BY)
VALUES (nextval('SEQ_CORE_NUMBER_SERIES'), 1, 'SHOP_ORDER', 'ORD', '{PREFIX}-{YYYY}-{SEQ:6}', 'YEARLY', 'system');
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->

## Do not rebuild

<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:START -->
A counter table or column, `MAX(ORDER_NO) + 1`, a database sequence read by the module for a document number, a
pattern parser, a yearly reset, a per-branch counter that ignores the tenant.
<!-- KEEP:do-not-rebuild:END -->
